note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative, jurisdiction unspecified; the difference between A and B is a supplied status, and nothing is decided by the animation.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional club rule with three cumulative conditions. A: all three pieces supplied — the line turns as a whole and the joint dial moves. B: identical except piece 2 is pending — it is withdrawn, its pocket stays empty and the same test turn stops at the gap.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a four-condition allotment rule where the changed piece 3 is DISPUTED in B (brought but not seated, tilted, not resolved here) instead of pending; B's line turns only up to piece 3.

rules.name: Rule G-4 (fictional allotment rule): transferring a garden plot

facts.label: Request dated Day 1, signed by L. Varga
Notice pinned on the shed on Day 3

issues: Does the committee accept the inspection note?
assumptions: Statuses as supplied by the committee secretary

scenarioA.label: All four pieces supplied
scenarioA.caption: The inspection note is accepted by both parties

scenarioB.label: Piece 3 disputed
scenarioB.caption: The inspection note is contested (not resolved here)

params.changedFact: Inspection note (piece 3): supplied in A, disputed in B

comparisonLabels.guide: Only the status of piece 3 differs
comparisonLabels.neutral: A and B are otherwise identical; the dispute is not resolved here.

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Five long conditions and facts, long scenario labels and captions, a long changed fact, long shared facts and a long neutral note; piece 4 pending in B.

rules.name: Rule M-12 (fictional housing co-operative rule): approving a shared workshop in the basement storage area
conditions: Written application signed by at least one registered member
Floor plan of the basement area attached to the application
Written consent of the neighbouring storage-unit holders
Safety inspection of the electrical installation recorded
Annual usage fee paid into the co-operative account (hypothetical)

facts.label: Application form WS-3 signed by member Maria-Fernanda Castellanos Villavicencio on Day 4
Hand-drawn floor plan of storage bays 7 to 9 attached as annex A
Consent letters from all three neighbouring unit holders
Caretaker's inspection note dated Day 11 for the basement circuits
Bank slip for the annual usage fee (hypothetical amount, reference 55-B)

issues: Which of the five pieces required by Rule M-12 are supplied in each scenario?
assumptions: Every fact is taken exactly as supplied by the applicant

scenarioA.label: All five pieces supplied by the applicant
scenarioA.caption: The caretaker's inspection note has been handed in with the other four documents

scenarioB.label: Inspection note still pending
scenarioB.caption: Identical application, except that the caretaker has not yet recorded the inspection

params.changedFact: Caretaker's inspection note for the basement circuits (piece 4): supplied in A, not yet supplied in B
sharedFacts: Same Rule M-12 of the housing co-operative
Same application form, floor plan, consent letters and bank slip
Same test turn of the joint mechanism

comparisonLabels.guide: Only piece 4, the caretaker's inspection note, differs
comparisonLabels.neutral: Everything else is identical in A and B; the animation does not decide whether the workshop is approved.
